sloka: अन्या कमल पत्र अक्षी पूर्ण इन्दु सद्र्श आनना ।अन्याम् आलिन्ग्य सुश्रोणी प्रसुप्ता मद विह्वला ॥५-१०-४८॥
transliteration: anyā kamala patra akṣī pūrṇa indu sadrśa ānanā ।anyām ālingya suśroṇī prasuptā mada vihvalā ॥5-10-48॥

translations.english: One woman with eyes like lotus petals and face like the fullmoon embraced another young woman of beautiful hips and slept tipsy with drink.
